drivingQuestion: In what case does the mishna rule half damage for kicking or pebbles?
outcomeNote: the dilemma is developed and left as teiku in the next unit

segments.he: הָיְתָה מְבַעֶטֶת, אוֹ שֶׁהָיוּ צְרוֹרוֹת מְנַתְּזִין מִתַּחַת רַגְלֶיהָ, וְשָׁבְרָה אֶת הַכֵּלִים – מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: הֵיכִי קָאָמַר?
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: If the animal «was kicking» while it was walking, «or» it occurred «that pebbles were» inadvertently «propelled from under its feet and» those pebbles «broke vessels,» the owner of the animal «pays half» the cost of «the damage. A dilemma was raised before» the Sages: With regard to «what» case «is» the tanna of the mishna «speaking?»

moves.summary: mishna lemma: kicking or pebbles pay half damage
moves.about: a kicking animal or pebbles from under its feet pay half damage
